description: Q11: E5's declared RATE_PARAM `threshold` measured against D27's 4x requirement, by simulating the SPEC 4.6 deterministic rule on test_G3's drive. Measured before any encoder was written, because the answer changes the constructor signature.
params_comment: Defaults from SPEC 4.6 and the tests/conftest.py registry entry for E5. The envelope gating the crossings is taken as the Hilbert envelope of the drive; SPEC 4.6 does not say which envelope, which is the first half of Q12.
